r.정치 구도: A constitutional monarchy with the king as head of state and a prime minister, backed by parliament, leading the government. Its 17 autonomous communities run much of education and health care, so regional governments carry real weight. Two big parties long took turns in power, but new parties emerged after the economic crisis of the 2010s, and single-party majorities have become hard to win. After the 2023 election the center-left Socialists formed a government with a left-wing alliance, relying on Catalan and Basque regional parties for support. The price was a 2024 amnesty law for people prosecuted over Catalonia's 2017 independence referendum, which proved deeply divisive. Some of those allies later walked away; the 2023 budget had to be rolled over three times, and when parliament blocked the government's housing measures in October 2026, the prime minister called a snap general election for November 29. Polls suggest the center-right People's Party and the far-right Vox could win a majority together.

t.why: The EU's fourth-largest economy, it is bound by language and history to the Spanish-speaking countries of Latin America and often acts as a bridge between Europe and that region. It faces Africa across the Strait of Gibraltar, so migrants arriving in the Canary Islands, Ceuta and Melilla are a constant diplomatic issue. It is a NATO member with relatively low defense spending, and in 2025, when NATO agreed to spend 5% of GDP on defense, Spain said it would not follow that target, clashing with the United States. In 2024 it recognized Palestine as a state together with Ireland and Norway, and in March 2026, when the United States and Israel attacked Iran, it barred the use of the Rota and Moron bases in the south, saying the strikes lacked a basis in international law. That makes it one of the Western European governments most willing to break with Washington. With Britain out of the EU, Spain negotiated separately over border crossings into British Gibraltar and reached a framework deal in 2025.
t.rel: Across the sea from Morocco, migration and territorial issues are intertwined, and it holds Ceuta and Melilla on the African side. British Gibraltar is a long-standing issue too.
t.korea: Diplomatic relations were established in March 1950. The Korea-EU free trade agreement, in force since 2011, lets most goods move between them without tariffs. Ties were upgraded to a strategic partnership during a Korean presidential state visit to Spain in 2021, and the following year a Spanish prime minister came to Korea for bilateral talks for the first time since relations began. Spanish pork vies with American pork for the top spot among Korea's pork imports, and in 2026 it even overtook US pork in monthly volume. Spain is also one of the European destinations Koreans visit most.
t.know: It is divided into 17 autonomous communities, and some also use Catalan, Basque or Galician as official languages.
etext: More than 90 million foreign visitors a year make it one of the world's tourism giants. Beaches, city culture and food are all strong draws, and tourism supports a large share of jobs and foreign earnings. In the most crowded cities, though, rising house prices and rents have triggered a backlash from residents.

It is Europe's second-largest car producer after Germany. Most plants belong to foreign carmakers rather than Spanish brands, and the cars they build are sold across Europe. It is the world's largest olive oil producer and exports large amounts of fruit, vegetables and pork to Europe and Asia.

Plenty of sun and wind have driven fast growth in solar and wind power, which now generate more than half of its electricity. Wholesale power prices are low by European standards, which helps attract factories. In April 2025 a massive blackout hit the whole Iberian Peninsula, sparking debate over grid stability.

Its unemployment rate is among the highest in the EU, especially for young people. Labor productivity is low and public debt is high. A housing shortage that has pushed prices and rents sharply higher is widely seen as its biggest social problem.
